newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.013pts to 100.120.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.013pts to 100.120.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.013 points in Monday's trading to 100.120, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio fell 0.008 points to 2.345 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.055 points to 96.172, the bank said, while the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.008 points to 2.371 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 1.082 points to 1,169.904.
